name: snowflake-access-explorer
summary: Read-only app explaining Snowflake RBAC access: who has what and through which path (CLAUDE.md:1-3). Reads TBL_ACCESS_ snapshot tables or, in Direct mode, ACCOUNT_USAGE then INFORMATION_SCHEMA then SHOW (access.py:1222); access.py holds the data, walks and 29 rules; server.py serves one React app locally (web/) and inside Streamlit in Snowflake (app.py:22).

name: api
summary: API client of the React app: get / useApi over a swappable transport (fetch locally, the Streamlit bridge inside Snowflake), a URL over LONG_URL goes as a POST body (web/src/api/client.ts:39-53, client.ts:92); types.ts holds the answer types of every page.

name: components
summary: Shared React components used by both versions: Graph (xyflow + elk, focus and Show all), DataTable, Findings, PrivilegeTabs, LoadLog, Combo, the kit (RiskStrip, NameList, chips, bars; web/src/components/kit.tsx:175, kit.tsx:297), visuals, code output and graph helpers, plus their vitest files.

name: pages
summary: One React page per screen (Home, Access, User, Role, Object, Check, Map, Sensitive, Risks, Review, What if, Granted vs used, Object activity, What changed, ...), the page helpers (common.tsx ScopePick web/src/pages/common.tsx:218, homedata.ts Home takeaways and Needs attention web/src/pages/homedata.ts:52, verdict, who, history, signoff, changeplan) and their vitest files.
